The G7 configuration is a one-time setup that lets the bridge collect data from G7 sensors — the same QR code xDrip+ loads as its G7 documentation describes (Settings → Auto configure). How to do it: 1) tap “From the xDrip+ documentation” or scan that QR code with the camera, 2) tap “Send to bridge”. Once per bridge is enough — it does not need to be repeated for each sensor and survives firmware updates. The QR code is read on this phone and sent only to your bridge.

The bridge disconnects from the sensor and stops connecting to it, also after a restart. About 15 minutes later the sensor can be paired in xDrip+ (G7) or in the Dexcom app. To go back to the bridge, enter the code under New sensor.
The bridge is not connecting to any sensor. To change that, enter the code under New sensor.

Removes the phones’ pairing with the bridge (the sensor stays). Then forget “G7 Bridge” in the phone’s Bluetooth settings, unplug and replug the bridge’s power and pair the phone again within 10 minutes.

A Dexcom G7 sensor only talks to a phone a few metres away. So at practice, in PE or on the playground the phone has to come along — in a running belt, a hip bag or a pocket that bounces with every step. It is uncomfortable, it gets in the way of the game, and phones get broken.

G7 Bridge is a small, light module that fits in a pocket. It stays close to the sensor, reads the glucose every 5 minutes and passes it on to the phone, which can stay in the locker room or on the bench — up to about 50 m away. xDrip+ and AndroidAPS keep working as usual, and if the phone is briefly out of range, the bridge keeps the readings and sends them as soon as the link is back.
The goal is simple: let the child just train — with the parent still seeing every reading.
Hobby project, not a medical device. Make treatment decisions based on approved devices.

xDrip+ is still the main app: set up its settings and alerts as the xDrip+ documentation describes, including the “Missed readings” alert (e.g. after 20 min) allowed through Do Not Disturb. G7 Bridge only tells you the reason and warns about the bridge’s battery.
